authority: Implementation authorized; the PRD/SRS explicitly reserve pilot corpus, oracle ownership, run budget and generator invocation authority for separate approval.
missing_prerequisites: Owner-approved stratified corpus and eligibility labels, with historical versus synthetic origin disclosed
Independent oracle owner and frozen evaluator-only fault variants/expected-failure details
Approved local execution budget: proposed 120 seconds per focused run and 30 minutes per arm remain proposals
Approved generator profile/model, invocation cap and spending authority for each isolated baseline/candidate arm
Generator-visible workspaces whose tool/filesystem boundaries exclude held-out evaluator artifacts and the other arm
dispatch_order: Independent evaluator freezes public generator-input manifest separately from evaluator-only cases and protocol
Separate baseline and candidate generators receive digest-bound allowed inputs only
Correct-implementation verification and suite/input-access manifest freeze before held-out evaluation
Evaluator adjudicates static findings, evidence validity and executed behavioral detections in separate strata
go_criterion: No false-clean evidence decisions, no lost baseline held-out detections, at least one additional valid held-out behavioral fault detection, zero false blocking on legitimate controls, within approved budgets. Improvements in static/evidence strata alone do not satisfy behavioral improvement.
